name: Grand Prix 5000 AS TR

origin.basis: Continental's bicycle tires are marketed from its German site; Germany-made lines are marked 'Handmade in Germany'.

positioning: All-season version of the 5000 S TR with more puncture protection, a thicker tread and a reinforced sidewall for year-round riding.
hookless_note: Continental lists hookless maximum pressures (73 psi up to 28 mm, 65 psi at 32 mm, 58 psi at 35 mm).
weight_basis: Continental black-sidewall claims per size; cream sidewalls add 10 g.

wet_notes.summary: Continental claims superior grip in all-weather conditions for this all-season version.

availability.note: Continental's official Tmall store sells it in mainland China; Continental's German and US catalogs list it for retailers.

price_observations.market: Continental official Tmall store (德国马牌轮胎官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 683.08.

caveats: Heavier and slower-rolling than the 5000 S TR in the same lab test; chosen for wet grip and protection.
No 30 mm size; 32 and 35 mm need a frame with that clearance.
Use the hookless pressure limit on hookless rims.
